title: Analytic: Bragg stack band diagram (Bloch FDTD)
description:
One unit cell of a 1D quarter-wave Bragg stack (n1 = 2 / d1 = 150 nm, n2 = 1.5 / d2 = 200 nm, a = 350 nm, n1 d1 = n2 d2 = 300 nm), every face periodic, Bloch wave vector bloch_kx = k_fraction 2 pi / a swept over 0.05-0.5 (Gamma to X). A point-source pulse rings the cell (E_z) and a resonance finder lists the band frequencies at each k.
Analytic (Rytov, quarter-wave cell, phase phi = n1 d1 omega / c in both layers): cos(K a) = cos^2(phi) - rho sin^2(phi), rho = (n1/n2 + n2/n1)/2, so cos^2(phi) = (cos(K a) + rho) / (1 + rho); band 1 f = c phi / (2 pi n1 d1), band 2 uses pi - phi. Gap at K = pi / a between lambda_gap_lo = 1.0996 um and lambda_gap_hi = 1.3205 um (centre f_mid, 1.2 um).
Sweep tab: 'Table column vs k_fraction: em.bands frequency' shows frequency_1 (band 1) and frequency_2 (band 2) with the dashed analytic bands (wavelength: wavelength_1 = band 2, wavelength_2 = band 1); derived band1_f / band2_f (the band below / above f_mid) carry the same references.
Expected agreement: ~0.1 % (FDTD numerical dispersion at >= 60 cells per wavelength in the n = 2 layer; 5 nm cells put every interface on a cell face).

parameters.name: d2
parameters.description: thickness of layer 2 (40 cells); n2 d2 = n1 d1 (quarter-wave)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: periodic y period (4 cells; y harmonics lie far above the band)

parameters.name: k_fraction
parameters.description: Bloch kx in units of 2 pi / a (swept 0.05-0.5)

parameters.name: Ka
parameters.description: Bloch phase per cell K a [rad]

parameters.name: phi1
parameters.description: layer phase phi of band 1 at this K [rad]

parameters.name: f_mid
parameters.description: gap centre frequency [Hz] (1.2 um), splits band 1 from band 2

parameters.name: phi_edge
parameters.description: phi at the band edge K = pi / a

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: source x (cell centre, off the layer centres and interfaces)

parameters.name: x_mon
parameters.description: resonance finder x (cell centre, in layer 2 off its centre)

parameters.name: T_run
parameters.description: study duration: > 10 periods of the longest searched wavelength
